title: HR Administrator
description:
HR Administrator

Join Our Team as an HR Administrator
Are you an organised, proactive HR professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment? We're looking for a motivated HR Administrator to join our growing team and provide high-quality support across the full employee life cycle.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone who is a self-starter, confident about using HR systems and technology, and passionate about delivering an excellent employee experience.
The Role
As HR Administrator, you will play a key role in supporting the HR function, ensuring processes run smoothly and accurately across recruitment, onboarding, employee records, and HR administration.
Key responsibilities include:
- Managing employee records and maintaining HR databases
- Supporting recruitment activities, including arranging interviews and issuing offer documentation
- Coordinating onboarding and induction processes for new starters
- Processing contractual changes, letters, and employee correspondence
- Assisting with payroll administration and benefits information
- Producing HR reports and analysing workforce data
- Supporting managers and employees with HR-related queries
- Ensuring compliance with employment legislation and company policies
- Assisting with HR projects and continuous improvement initiatives

About You
We're looking for an individual who is:
- A self-starter who can work independently and take ownership of tasks
- Highly organised with excellent attention to detail
- Tech-savvy and confident using HR systems, Microsoft Office, and digital tools
- Comfortable managing multiple priorities and meeting deadlines
- A strong communicator with excellent interpersonal skills
- Proactive, adaptable, and solution-focused
- Discreet and professional when handling confidential information

Skills & Experience
- Previous experience in an HR Administration or HR Assistant role
- Good understanding of HR processes and employee life cycle activities
- Experience using HRIS or HR management systems
- Strong Excel and Microsoft Office skills
- CIPD Level 3 qualification (desirable but not essential)
- Excellent administrative and organisational abilities

What We Offer
- Competitive salary and benefits package
- Opportunities for professional development and career progression
- Supportive and collaborative working environment
- Flexible and modern working practices
- The chance to be part of a forward-thinking organisation

If you're a proactive HR professional looking for your next challenge and enjoy working in a dynamic environment where you can make a real impact, we'd love to hear from you.
If you're interested in this role, click 'apply now' to forward an up-to-date copy of your CV, or call us now.
If this job isn't quite right for you, but you are looking for a new position, please contact us for a confidential discussion about your career.

description:
Our client, a global business with a market leading reputation, is recruiting a Customer Experience Representative. This company are known for innovation, technical expertise and being an excellent employer.

Client Details

This role is working for a global business based in Derbyshire. The role would initially be temporary for 12 months, but is highly likely to be extended beyond that and could in future become a permanent role.

Description

Working as part of the order to cash team.

Dealing with purchase orders, processing the PO in SAP, raising PO's for 3rd parties.

Liaise heavily with commercial and sales teams.

Deal with stock and logistics.

title: Service Technical Planner
description:
Job Role: Service Technical Planner

Location: Chesterfield, S41

Our client a well established manufacturing organisation based in Chesterfield is seeking a dedicated and detail-oriented Service Technical Planner to join their dynamic, friendly Service Administration team.

This exciting role is crucial in ensuring the efficient delivery of contracted service works and reactive breakdowns and repairs, while optimising resource utilisation and maintaining high standards of customer satisfaction.

As a Service Technical Planner, your role will include:
- Validate contracted service jobs prior to scheduling.
- Verify customer details, site access information, and equipment data.
- Determine required engineering competency and resources required.
- Route works to maximise efficiency and minimise travel time.
- Protect diary capacity to accommodate reactive breakdowns.
- Balance engineer workload for strong utilisation.
- Issue complete job packs, including RAMS, stock, and access details.
- Ensure engineers are fully briefed and equipped.
- Communicate schedule updates promptly to relevant parties.
- Support achievement of first-time fix performance.
- Respond promptly to urgent breakdowns in line with SLA requirements.
- Reprioritise schedules when necessary and manage customer expectations during delays.
- Issue certifications promptly and close jobs within the system.
- Track reactive versus planned workload balance and provide performance data to the Service Manager.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives.

Our client is looking for a candidate who embodies the following competencies and experience:
- Strong organisational and planning capabilities.
- High attention to detail and accuracy.
- Ability to manage competing priorities under pressure.
- Proactive problem-solving and decision-making skills.
- Clear and confident communication skills.
- Analytical mindset focused on efficiency and performance improvement.
- Team-oriented with strong accountability and a robust work ethic.
- Experience in technical scheduling, logistics planning, or field service coordination, preferably within engineering services, utilities, HVAC, telecoms, or similar sectors.
- Proficient in IT, including scheduling systems, CRM software, and route optimisation tools.
- Understanding of service-level agreements and performance metrics.

Working Hours - Monday to Friday 8:30am - 5:00pm office based

If you are a proactive individual with a passion for optimising service delivery and enhancing customer satisfaction, this is an excellent opportunity to advance your career. The organisation offers a supportive environment where your contributions will be valued and recognised.

To apply, please submit your CV detailing your relevant experience. Our client are looking to hire as soon as possible so please do apply today!

title: Talent Coordinator
description:
Talent Coordinator (FTC Maternity Cover)

Derby Part-time (25 hours, Monday Friday)
£27,500 pro rata

Ganymede and ATA Recruitment are specialist recruitment businesses delivering engineering and technical talent across the UK s infrastructure and transportation sectors.

We re looking for a Talent Coordinator to provide dedicated administrative and coordination support across our internal recruitment function. This is a key support role, ensuring the smooth running of internal recruitment, onboarding, and training activity across both brands, on a fixed-term contract maternity cover.

This role is ideal for someone highly organised, detail-focused, and confident working in a fast-paced environment where accuracy and coordination are essential.

Your contracted office location will be our Head Office in Derby. Following completion of your training, you will be able to utilise our agile working policy, working predominantly from home with travel to the office required as needed.

What You ll Be Doing

A hands-on coordination role focused on administration, systems management, and supporting recruitment activity:

Recruitment & Coordination Support
- Providing day-to-day administrative support to the Talent Manager
- Coordinating internal recruitment activity from advertising through to interview stage
- Managing candidate communications and responding to queries
- Screening applications and supporting shortlisting activity
- Scheduling interviews, meetings, and assessment activity
- Maintaining accurate candidate records within the CRM system

Systems & Administration
- Managing and updating recruitment and interview platforms
- Maintaining dashboards, trackers, and reporting information
- Supporting recruitment marketing administration and ad responses
- Collating and organising recruitment and EDI data

Training & LMS Support
- Administering our internal LMS (Ganymede Academy) for internal and external users
- Uploading content, managing user access, and tracking completion
- Generating reports on training activity and engagement
- Supporting coordination of onboarding and internal training materials
- Supplying training reports and data for audits

What We re Looking For
- Previous administration or coordination experience, ideally in a recruitment or sales setting
- Great organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities
- High attention to detail and confidence handling data and systems
- Comfortable supporting others in a fast-paced, structured environment
- Strong IT skills (MS Office Outlook, Word, Excel)
- Clear, confident communicator with a proactive attitude

Why Join Us?
- A support-focused role at the centre of internal recruitment activity
- Exposure to recruitment, onboarding, and learning systems
- Opportunity to build strong administrative and coordination skills within a growing business group

If you re looking for a structured, varied support role where accuracy and organisation are key, we d love to hear from you.

To apply or find out more, contact Rachael Bailey-Frost.

Ganymede is committed to creating a diverse workforce and is an equal opportunities employer. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified persons regardless of age, disability, gender, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, and sexual orientation
